basic_info.description: This stunning courtyard-facing unit offers serene views of a beautifully landscaped butterfly garden and comes with the added benefit of EV parking. Located in the sought-after Knox building at the intersection of Dogpatch and Potrero, this home is just a short walk to the 22nd Street Caltrain Station and 3rd Street Muni for effortless commuting. Inside, you'll find a spacious open floor plan with contemporary finishes and high-end appliances, including an in-unit washer & dryer. The stylish kitchen boasts a striking white quartz island, perfect for cooking & entertaining. Expansive east-facing windows flood the space with natural light while showcasing the lush garden below.  Built in 2017, this unit feels like new & offers modern conveniences such as NEST air conditioning, a secure parking space with EV charging, additional storage & bike storage. Knox residents enjoy premium amenities, including a fitness center, media room, landscaped courtyard with fire pits and BBQ area, bike room, package room, ButterflyMX intercom system & a lobby attendant.
